packageRules.description: The copier template source in .copier-answers.yml has no Renovate datasource — a bare `gh:` path resolves as git-tags and always reports 'no-result', which every stamped app then carries as a permanent repository problem on its Dependency Dashboard. The value is correct and is bumped by `copier update`, never by Renovate.

psycopg-binary publishes no Python 3.15 wheel, so a stamped app's backend install fails on a 3.15 image (eight#149, 22/10/2026). Holds the Python runtime and the uv image below 3.15 for every app. Retires when psycopg-binary ships cp315 wheels.

TypeScript 7 (the native compiler) is held below 7. Upstream is not ready: typescript-eslint's peer is <6.1, svelte-check's is ^5 || ^6, @sveltejs/kit 3 and @sveltejs/package 3 peer ^6, and `svelte-kit sync`, dev and build crash on 7.0.2 (sveltejs/kit#17537; svelte2tsx and svelte-check crash, sveltejs/language-tools#3063; typescript-eslint tracks it in typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint#10940). Retires when those three land TS 7 support.

SvelteKit 3, adapter-static 4 and @sveltejs/package 3 move together and are held. Upstream blocker: bits-ui (every app's and @poodle64/ui's component base) pulls runed 0.35, whose peer is @sveltejs/kit ^2 (huntabyte/bits-ui#2243, 'SvelteKit 3 support'). Also measured 02/11/2026: @sveltejs/package 3 no longer rewrites `$lib` in dist, so a built @poodle64/ui ships unresolvable `$lib/…` imports (a consumer's build fails 'Could not load src/lib/utils.js'), and kit 3 drops `$lib`, svelte.config.js and `$app/stores` for `#lib`, the Vite plugin options and `$app/state` — a fleet-wide source rewrite (`npx sv migrate sveltekit-3`) to run as one factory change after bits-ui lands. Tracked in radar-hooves/app-factory#60.
adapter-static 4 peers @sveltejs/kit ^3, so it is held with SvelteKit 3 (see the rule above; radar-hooves/app-factory#60).

@tanstack/table-core 9 is a rewrite, not an upgrade: table features are declared up front (`_features`), `getCoreRowModel`/`getSortedRowModel`/`getFilteredRowModel` become `createCoreRowModel`/`createSortedRowModel`/`createFilteredRowModel`, and `ColumnDef` takes extra type arguments. @poodle64/ui re-exports `ColumnDef` and wraps `createTable` in `createSvelteTable`, so the bump breaks the table API every app calls (svelte-check: 27 errors in ui alone, measured 02/11/2026). Not an upstream fault: a deliberate @poodle64/ui major, with the apps' tables migrated beside it, tracked in radar-hooves/app-factory#61.
